pandas.plotting.table

pandas 3.1.1 · Plotting · function

Add a table of pandas values to a Matplotlib axes.

  • Call syntax
  • Inspect the call
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.plotting.table(ax, data, **kwargs)

Inspect the call

Run this code to inspect the callable and its parameters. Its data, backend, or environment is needed to execute the operation itself.

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
frame = pd.DataFrame({"units": [2., 5., 7.], "price": [4., 3., 2.]})
print(pd.plotting.table(plt.subplots()[1], frame))
